## Audited omission
Our latest method correctly notes **stationary changed matter can be ecological memory**. We should not disqualify a source just because ordinary bodies move zero distance between minute1 and minute2. Does our EXISTING physical B01b donor genuinely retain a changed affordance after an actual world process ceases, or does it settle back and reblock? If not, we must not build autobiographical cognition on it.

## Frozen substrate and three interventions, no controller
Use **unchanged** `createB01bScenario`, `stepB01bScenario`, `isB01bPassageOpen` and Rapier 120Hz. Include same ordinary loose blocker, same shuttle, static physical walls and clearance radius1.0. No extra floor, color tag, teleport, reset, outside reward, actor insertion, changes to motor/physics. Compare 3 histories from identical t0 setup:
- `never`: `processEnabled=false` all 120 seconds; shuttle stays as ordinary undriven body.
- `early-only`: independent shuttle physical process ON through tick **1200 (10s)**, then **source motor turned off**; the physical shuttle and blocker remain in the same World, both subject to damping/collisions. Turning off the power is an explicit *experimenter intervention*, not life or agency.
- `always`: source motor ON all 120 seconds. Its motion cannot itself count as ordinary-matter movement.

At **t0, t1200 (10s), t3600 (30s), t7200 (60s), t10800 (90s), t14400 (120s)** record: host audit of B0-sized physical clearance, blocker and shuttle current positions, blocker speed, actual blocker displacement from t0, source powered state, source–blocker contact event count, and B01b source process first-touch/first-open.
Also accumulate ordinary blocker displacement from one-second physical positions in each of four 30s windows **separately from shuttle**. Record real `executedUpdates==14400` and non-identity of real physical snapshots at t0 versus final where meaningful. Repeat early-only exactly once to test determinism. This is NOT a claim that a body lived 120 seconds.
Important: `isB01bPassageOpen` is **host-only geometry analysis**; it isn't a private perception, a learned representation, or proof an actor can exploit it.

## Pre-declared scientific decision
- Early-only passes *persistent material affordance* ONLY if blocker was truly contacted by independent shuttle during first10s, the B0 clearance became open before10s, and it stays open at all four post-30s snapshots while source is OFF; late (60–120s) blocker travel should be negligible (<=0.03 total) and blocker position should meaningfully differ from `never` (>=0.9). If early-only fails, preserve the FAILED source hypothesis; don't adjust power cutoff or walls post hoc.
